definitions.explanation: A continuous downward movement in numbers, quality, or performance, visualized as a line on a graph sloping down from left to right. Used for economic indicators, sales, population, and other measurable trends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{右肩下|みぎかたさ}がりだ。
examples.english: Sales are on a downward trend.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右肩下|みぎかたさ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The market size of this industry continues to decline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{右肩下|みぎかたさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{統廃合|とうはいごう}→統廃合：07889_touhaigou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: In regions with declining populations, school consolidations are progressing.

notes:
USAGE:
The image comes from reading a graph left to right: if the line slopes downward, the right shoulder ({右肩|みぎかた}) of the line is lower. This is a very common expression in business and economic reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右肩下|みぎかたさ}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (the decline continues)
- {右肩下|みぎかたさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (downward trend)
- {右肩下|みぎかたさ}がり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (declining graph)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{右肩上|みぎかたあ}がり→右肩上がり：15106_migikataagari⟧: upward trend, rising (antonym)
- ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: decline, decrease
- ⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧: decrease, reduction
